note: PASS with caveats. (1) Instrument identity: the dictionary Description calls this a '26-item, 1-7 Likert questionnaire on motivations for lecture-hall seating choice'. It is not: the 26 items are the Motivated Strategies for Learning Questionnaire (Pintrich et al. 1991) motivation section, administered to study whether seat row predicts academic motivation. The S2 workbook's 'codes' sheet prints all 26 stems and they are MSLQ motivation items 1,2,4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12,13,15,16,17,18,20,21,22,23,24,25,26,27,29,30,31 in order -- i.e. the MSLQ motivation block with its five test-anxiety items (3,8,14,19,28) dropped, renumbered Q1..Q26. instrument field set accordingly; dictionary Description should be corrected. (2) Administered in French: the paper states 'we had to translate the items into French. The translated questionnaire was not tested in preliminary studies.' No French wording appears in the paper or in either supporting file (S1 Graph, S2 Data), so the base text fields carry the English the deposit itself prints and the _translated columns are empty -- text_source=translated_substitute. (3) Transcribed verbatim from the 'codes' sheet including its two departures from the published MSLQ wording: Q5 'in the reading for this course' (MSLQ: 'readings') and Q9 '...my main concern in this class i getting a good grade' (MSLQ: 'is getting'). Not corrected. (4) instructions left blank: neither the paper nor the deposit reproduces the questionnaire instructions. option_text carries only the two anchors the paper states, 1 'not at all true of me' and 7 'very true of me'; scale points 2-6 are unlabelled and left blank, not padded. (5) Rights: MSLQ, register verdict 'ship' (U-Michigan NCRIPTAL, public domain, citation only) applied, not re-derived. (6) Response-data observations, not item-text problems: live per-item n is 593 for 22 items and 591-592 for QUESTIO18/19/20/23, because the S2 'data' sheet holds a stray BOM character in row 560 (QUESTIO18/19/20) and the typo '²5' in QUESTIO20 row 438 and QUESTIO23 row 360, which the processing script coerces to NA and drops. Also cov_seat_rank_preference is not a preference: the S2 column RANK is the lecture-hall row the student actually occupied (1-9), which the paper describes as assigned by the researcher on the day.
public_note: Item text is shown in English. Uffler et al. administered the MSLQ in French translation and neither the paper nor the deposit publishes the French wording, so the English printed in the study's own codebook ships instead of what respondents read.
